Creativism Club project page↗

The initiative

From an idea to something useful.

As president of the 30-member Creativism Club, I connect student engineering with public learning and community outreach. I directed DRONEVERSE, a drone exhibition in Ho Chi Minh City that reached 500 people, and co-organized a CS & STEM program for 30 students from disadvantaged backgrounds at Darahoa charity classroom in Lam Dong.

500DRONEVERSE reach
30Creativism Club members
30Darahoa students
VND 10m30 Darahoa gift packages
01

DRONEVERSE: lead a shared platform

I directed DRONEVERSE in Ho Chi Minh City, a public exhibition bringing together drones, robotics, motors, computer science, and student engineering projects.

02

Connect with specialist knowledge

We partnered with IsLab, a laboratory specializing in drones and AI-enabled drone systems, for expert talks and technical demonstrations.

03

Share the process

As a featured student speaker, I explained the ideation, prototyping, and testing journey behind student-led drone and engineering projects.

04

Darahoa: co-organize community learning

I co-organized a CS & STEM program at Darahoa charity classroom in Lam Dong, introducing 30 students from disadvantaged backgrounds to computer science, logical thinking, and simple STEM experiments. The program distributed 30 gift packages with a total value of VND 10 million.

Leadership in practice

Darahoa · Learning together

The CS & STEM program at Darahoa charity classroom in Lam Dong introduced 30 students from disadvantaged backgrounds to computer science, logical thinking, and simple experiments. We also distributed 30 gift packages totaling VND 10 million.
